title: Here’s How to Get Disney+ Online for Free
summary: Disney+ doesn't offer a free trial. However, there's a way to get streaming access at no cost.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

If you’re thinking about joining Disney+, a free trial is the best way to test out a streaming platform to see if it’s a good fit. However, Disney+ doesn’t offer a free trial anymore, but we found a clever workaround to watch movies and TV shows for free.

Get DirecTV 5-day Free Trial

These days, there are a number of live TV streaming platforms that include Disney+, as well as other channels that’ll get you access to hit movies, TV shows and documentaries from The Walt Disney Company, Marvel Studios, Pixar Animation, Lucasfilm, Twentieth Century Studios, Hulu, National Geographic and much more online at home.

The streaming service also has a wide selection of music specials and concert films, such as Taylor Swift: The Eras Tour (Taylor’s Version) , Elton John Live: Farewell from Dodger Stadium , The Beatles: Get Back , Ed Sheeran: The Sum of It All and others.

The streaming platforms below include promos and free trials that’ll help save you additional money while allowing you to watch Disney+ online for free.

UNLIMITED DVR

DirecTV

Get 5-Day Free Trial

Get access to Disney+.

DirecTV is offering a five-day free trial , which will let you watch Disney+ for free. Access to the streaming app comes with all of its signature packages, which include unlimited DVR storage. In addition, you’ll get access to local channels and the ability to stream on up to three devices at the same time.

NO HIDDEN FEES

Hulu + Live TV

Get 3-day free trial

With a three-day free trial, Hulu + Live TV gives you access to Disney+, in addition to more than 100 live TV channels for $89.99 per month. And, you can expand your content library by bundling Hulu + Live TV with Hulu and ESPN Unlimited too.

About Disney+

Disney+

Get Disney+

Get Disney+ and Hulu plans starting at $9.99 per month.

Disney+ plans start at $7.99 per month for the ad-supported plan, while you can go ad free for $13.99 per month. For even more content, Disney+ offers a bundle with Disney+ and Hulu, which starts at $9.99 per month. You can add ESPN Unlimited to Disney+ and Hulu starting at $35.99 per month.

Meanwhile, if you’re not into ESPN Unlimited, you can add HBO Max to Disney+ and Hulu instead with prices starting at $19.99 per month.
